datasets.description: Esta base contiene el resultado final del cálculo de las severidades, la Población en Necesidad (PiN) y las desagregaciones poblacionales para el Clúster de Agua, Saneamiento e Higiene (WASH), Colombia 2024.. entity.name: UNGRD (Unidad Nacional de Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres)

lineage.description: Population in need (PiN) calculated by integrating DANE census data on water sources, sanitation infrastructure, and waste collection with health indicators (waterborne diseases, malnutrition), natural disaster exposure from UNGRD, armed conflict data from MONITOR, and El Niño probability. Severity indices were computed for each factor, weighted and aggregated to produce final PiN estimates disaggregated by department, municipality, and population subgroups (age, rural/urban).

sources.name: DANE (Departamento Administrativo Nacional de Estadística)
sources.description: Population census data 2024, water source quality indicators, sanitation coverage, and waste collection statistics used to calculate severity indices

sources.name: UNGRD (Unidad Nacional de Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres)
sources.description: Natural disaster occurrence records and rates used as severity indicators for WASH needs assessment

sources.name: MONITOR (Conflict monitoring system)
sources.description: Armed conflict incident data and rates integrated as severity factor affecting WASH access
